title.en: The Prophet's ﷺ kindness: trust and mercy

topic: Trust in Allah made him brave; mercy made him forgive

learn.en: One day the Prophet ﷺ was resting alone under a tree near the battlefield, and fell asleep.
learn.title: Resting under a tree

learn.en: An enemy found him and raised a sword: “O Muhammad! Who will save you from me now?”
learn.title: “Who will save you?”

learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ calmly said: “Allah!” The man trembled with fear and dropped his sword.
learn.title: “Allah!”

learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ picked up the sword: “Now who will save you from me?” The man had no answer — and the Prophet ﷺ let him go.
learn.title: He forgave him

learn.en: Trust in Allah made him brave, and rahmah — mercy — made him kind even to people who were unkind to him.
learn.title: Rahmah: mercy

quiz.en: When the man asked “Who will save you?”, the Prophet ﷺ answered:
What did the Prophet ﷺ do with the man?
opts: He forgave him and let him go

quiz.en: True or false? Trust in Allah made the Prophet ﷺ brave.
True or false? We should only be kind to people who are kind to us.

think.q: Has someone ever been unkind to you? How does the Prophet's ﷺ example make you feel about forgiving them?
think.a: Forgiving is strong, not weak — just like the Prophet ﷺ.

parents.summary: The Prophet ﷺ trusted Allah when threatened by a sword, then forgave the man: trust and mercy (raḥma).
parents.tip: Share a time you forgave someone, and how it felt.
